_note: SCHEMA SAMPLE ONLY. Topic names here are placeholders, not a real Cambridge list. Never save this file. Real profiles are written by the `curriculum` agent — see .claude/agents/curriculum.md.
schoolFocus: optional: what the school is covering this month

settings.reason: Age 10: short daily sessions; diagnostic spread over several sittings to limit fatigue.

research.notes: What was read, and any gaps or doubts. Say plainly which parts were confirmed against the source and which were recalled.

_groups: The teaching family a topic belongs to. `strand` alone is too coarse to be useful — a primary stage puts most topics under 'Number'. 3-8 topics per group.
_topics: `prereqs` lists DIRECT prerequisites only — the chain a parent sees is walked transitively, so listing grandparents makes it noisy. A prerequisite is a real dependency ('could a child who never did P still learn T?'), not merely what is taught before it.
